name: Question 1
worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${p}_{23}$, we remove the  $2$nd row and the $3$rd column:

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & ∗ & 1 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ -2 & 0 & ∗ & 2 \\ 11 & 3 & ∗ & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{23}=|\begin{aligned}-7 & 3 & \,1 \\ -2 & 0 & \,2 \\ 11 & 3 & \,-3\end{aligned}|.
$$
